scientific.integrity: The proof combines the published smoothing identification, the standard rational cohomology of weighted projective threefolds, the published Hodge numbers of the genus-10 prime Fano threefold, and the exact nearby/vanishing-cycle long exact sequence. No finite experiment is used as a proof substitute.
limitations: The statement is rational and does not determine integral torsion or the vanishing-cycle lattice.
The monodromy action and Hodge-theoretic splitting of the four-dimensional middle group are not computed.
The claim concerns the specific smoothing component identified with Y_10.

title: The Chen--Lee smoothing has four rational vanishing cycles in middle degree
